title: Store contract: record types, the one store interface, in-memory store, gh runner, store IPC and the Grillo folder layout rules
summary: Adds Grillo's one store interface over the PRD records, a full in-memory store, the typed gh runner, one IPC channel per store method plus settings, and the store layout document that pins every file and comment format; the GitHub backends are stubs.
friction: The store contract took three review rounds because the layout document named files and comments without pinning their contents; each round found more unpinned formats that issues #73, #74, #75 and #77 would have invented separately
lessons_learned: A contract story that several backends and skills read must pin every file and comment format field by field, not only name the files

deferred.what: A channel whose response type is `unknown` breaks the typecheck of `createGrilloApi`; the next story declaring such a response hits the same error (worked around here for `settings:get` with a JSON value type)

The layout document says `members.json` holds only login, role and domains (as PRD section 6.1 does), while issue #73 (GitHub repository backend) has an acceptance criterion that it holds login, name, email, role and domains; the issue #73 run must pick one

`addDecision` adds a settled map line per decision, so one closed ticket can hold several lines (two decisions, or a decision then a merge), against the one-line-per-closed-ticket rule; the outdated gist stays beside the current one
deferred.why: Found on the confirming review, no further round

deferred.what: `duplicateOf` is read from the latest merge decision rather than the latest decision, so a merge that was undone and later decided on its own still reads as a duplicate
deferred.why: Found on the confirming review, no further round
